en_question: A data engineer is configuring Amazon SageMaker Studio to use AWS Glue interactive sessions to prepare data for machine learning (ML) models. The data engineer receives an access denied error when the data engineer tries to prepare the data by using SageMaker Studio. Which change should the engineer make to gain access to SageMaker Studio?

en_options.A: Add the AWSGlueServiceRole managed policy to the data engineer's IAM user.
en_options.B: Add a policy to the data engineer's IAM user that includes the sts:AssumeRole action for the AWS Glue and SageMaker service principals in the trust policy.
en_options.C: Add the AmazonSageMakerFullAccess managed policy to the data engineer's IAM user.
en_options.D: Add a policy to the data engineer's IAM user that allows the sts:AddAssociation action for the AWS Glue and SageMaker service principals in the trust policy.

zh_question: 資料工程師正在設定AmazonSageMakerStudio以使用AWSGlue 互動式工作階段來為機器學習(ML)模型準備資料。 當資料工程師嘗試使用SageMakerStudio準備資料時，收到存取拒絕錯誤。 工程師應進行哪項變更才能取得SageMakerStudio的存取權限？

en_question: A company extracts approximately 1 TB of data every day from data sources such as SAP HANA, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, Apache Kafka, and Amazon DynamoDB. Some of the data sources have undefined data schemas or data schemas that change. A data engineer must implement a solution that can detect the schema for these data sources. The solution must extract, transform, and load the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has a service level agreement (SLA) to load the data into the S3 bucket within 15 minutes of data creation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Use Amazon EMR to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket. Create a pipeline in Apache Spark.
en_options.B: Use AWS Glue to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket. Create a pipeline in Apache Spark.
en_options.C: Create a PySpark program in AWS Lambda to extract, transform, and load the data into the S3 bucket.
en_options.D: Create a stored procedure in Amazon Redshift to detect the schema and to extract, transform, and load the data into a Redshift Spectrum table. Access the table from Amazon S3.

zh_question: 一家公司每天從SAPHANA、MicrosoftSQLServer、MongoDB、Apache Kafka和AmazonDynamoDB等資料來源提取約1TB的資料。部分資料來源 具有未定義的資料綱要，或其資料綱要會發生變動。 資料工程師必須實作一種解決方案，以偵測這些資料來源的綱要。該解決方案必 須將資料提取、轉換並載入至AmazonS3儲存貯體。該公司簽有服務層級協議 （SLA），規定必須在資料建立後15分鐘內將資料載入至S3儲存貯體。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company has multiple applications that use datasets that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has an ecommerce application that generates a dataset that contains personally identifiable information (PII). The company has an internal analytics application that does not require access to the PII. To comply with regulations, the company must not share PII unnecessarily. A data engineer needs to implement a solution that with redact PII dynamically, based on the needs of each application that accesses the dataset. Which solution will meet the requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Create an S3 bucket policy to limit the access each application has. Create multiple copies of the dataset. Give each dataset copy the appropriate level of redaction for the needs of the application that accesses the copy.
en_options.B: Create an S3 Object Lambda endpoint. Use the S3 Object Lambda endpoint to read data from the S3 bucket. Implement redaction logic within an S3 Object Lambda function to dynamically redact PII based on the needs of each application that accesses the data.
en_options.C: Use AWS Glue to transform the data for each application. Create multiple copies of the dataset. Give each dataset copy the appropriate level of redaction for the needs of the application that accesses the copy.
en_options.D: Create an API Gateway endpoint that has custom authorizers. Use the API Gateway endpoint to read data from the S3 bucket. Initiate a REST API call to dynamically redact PII based on the needs of each application that accesses the data.

zh_question: 一家公司擁有多個應用程式，這些應用程式使用儲存在AmazonS3儲存貯桶中 的資料集。該公司有一個電子商務應用程式，會產生包含個人識別資訊(PII)的 資料集。該公司還有一個內部分析應用程式，不需要存取PII。為了符合法規要 求，該公司不得非必要地共用PII。一名資料工程師需要實作一種解決方案，能 夠根據存取資料集的每個應用程式的需求，動態遮蔽PII。哪種解決方案能以最 低的營運開銷滿足這些需求？

en_question: A data engineer needs to build an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job. The ETL job will process daily incoming .csv files that users upload to an Amazon S3 bucket. The size of each S3 object is less than 100 MB. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

en_options.A: Write a custom Python application. Host the application on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.
en_options.B: Write a PySpark ETL script. Host the script on an Amazon EMR cluster.
en_options.C: Write an AWS Glue PySpark job. Use Apache Spark to transform the data.
en_options.D: Write an AWS Glue Python shell job. Use pandas to transform the data.

zh_question: 資料工程師需要建置一個提取、轉換和載入(ETL)工作。該ETL工作將處理使用 者上傳至AmazonS3儲存貯桶的每日傳入.csv檔案。每個S3物件的大小均小於 100MB。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

en_question: A data engineer creates an AWS Glue Data Catalog table by using an AWS Glue crawler that is named Orders. The data engineer wants to add the following new partitions: s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-01 s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023-01-02 The data engineer must edit the metadata to include the new partitions in the table without scanning all the folders and files in the location of the table. Which data definition language (DDL) statement should the data engineer use in Amazon Athena?

en_options.A: ALTER TABLE Orders ADD PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-01’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/order_date=2023-01-01’; ALTER TABLE Orders ADD PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-02’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/order_date=2023-01-02’;
en_options.B: MSCK REPAIR TABLE Orders;
en_options.C: REPAIR TABLE Orders;
en_options.D: ALTER TABLE Orders MODIFY PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-01’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/2023-01-01’; ALTER TABLE Orders MODIFY PARTITION(order_date=’2023-01-02’) LOCATION ‘s3://transactions/ orders/2023-01-02’;

zh_question: 一名資料工程師使用名為Orders的AWSGlue爬蟲程式建立了AWSGlue資料 目錄表。該資料工程師想要新增以下新分割區： s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023‑01‑01 s3://transactions/orders/order_date=2023‑01‑02 該資料工程師必須編輯中繼資料，將新分割區納入表中，而無需掃描該表位置中 的所有資料夾和檔案。 該資料工程師應在AmazonAthena中使用哪一個資料定義語言(DDL)陳述式？

en_question: A company stores 10 to 15 TB of uncompressed .csv files in Amazon S3. The company is evaluating Amazon Athena as a one-time query engine. The company wants to transform the data to optimize query runtime and storage costs. Which file format and compression solution will meet these requirements for Athena queries?

en_options.A: .csv format compressed with zip
en_options.B: JSON format compressed with bzip2
en_options.C: Apache Parquet format compressed with Snappy
en_options.D: Apache Avro format compressed with LZO

zh_question: 一家公司在AmazonS3中儲存了10到15TB的未壓縮.csv檔案。該公司 正在評估將AmazonAthena作為一次性查詢引擎。 該公司希望轉換資料格式，以最佳化查詢執行時間和儲存成本。 哪種檔案格式和壓縮解決方案能滿足這些針對Athena查詢的需求？

en_question: A company uses Apache Airflow to orchestrate the company's current on- premises data pipelines. The company runs SQL data quality check tasks as part of the pipelines. The company wants to migrate the pipelines to AWS and to use AWS managed services. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of refactoring?

en_options.A: Setup AWS Outposts in the AWS Region that is nearest to the location where the company uses Airflow. Migrate the servers into Outposts hosted Amazon EC2 instances. Update the pipelines to interact with the Outposts hosted EC2 instances instead of the on-premises pipelines.
en_options.B: Create a custom Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the Airflow application and the code that the company needs to migrate. Use the custom AMI to deploy Amazon EC2 instances. Update the network connections to interact with the newly deployed EC2 instances.
en_options.C: Migrate the existing Airflow orchestration configuration into Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA). Create the data quality checks during the ingestion to validate the data quality by using SQL tasks in Airflow.
en_options.D: Convert the pipelines to AWS Step Functions workflows. Recreate the data quality checks in SQL as Python based AWS Lambda functions.

zh_question: 一家公司使用ApacheAirflow來協調該公司目前的內部部署資料管線。該公司將 SQL資料品質檢查任務作為管線的一部分執行。該公司希望將管線遷移至AWS， 並使用AWS託管服務。 哪項解決方案能以最少量的重構滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company uses Amazon EMR as an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to transform data that comes from multiple sources. A data engineer must orchestrate the pipeline to maximize performance. Which AWS service will meet this requirement MOST cost effectively?

en_options.A: Amazon EventBridge
en_options.B: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)
en_options.C: AWS Step Functions
en_options.D: AWS Glue Workflows

zh_question: 一家公司使用AmazonEMR作為提取、轉換和載入(ETL)管線，以轉換來自 多個來源的資料。資料工程師必須協調該管線以最大化效能。 哪項AWS服務能以最具成本效益的方式滿足此需求？

en_question: An online retail company stores Application Load Balancer (ALB) access logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon Athena to query the logs to analyze traffic patterns. A data engineer creates an unpartitioned table in Athena. As the amount of the data gradually increases, the response time for queries also increases. The data engineer wants to improve the query performance in Athena. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

en_options.A: Create an AWS Glue job that determines the schema of all ALB access logs and writes the partition metadata to AWS Glue Data Catalog.
en_options.B: Create an AWS Glue crawler that includes a classifier that determines the schema of all ALB access logs and writes the partition metadata to AWS Glue Data Catalog.
en_options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform all ALB access logs. Save the results to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. Partition the metadata. Use Athena to query the transformed data.
en_options.D: Use Apache Hive to create bucketed tables. Use an AWS Lambda function to transform all ALB access logs.

zh_question: 一家線上零售公司將應用程式負載平衡器(ALB)存取記錄儲存在AmazonS3儲 存貯體中。該公司希望使用AmazonAthena來查詢這些記錄，以分析流量模式。 一名資料工程師在Athena中建立了一個未分割的表格。隨著資料量逐漸增加， 查詢的回應時間也隨之變長。該資料工程師希望提升Athena中的查詢效能。 哪項解決方案能以最小的營運工作量滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company has a business intelligence platform on AWS. The company uses an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway to transfer files from the company's on-premises environment to an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer needs to setup a process that will automatically launch an AWS Glue workflow to run a series of AWS Glue jobs when each file transfer finishes successfully. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Determine when the file transfers usually finish based on previous successful file transfers. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event to initiate the AWS Glue jobs at that time of day.
en_options.B: Set up an Amazon EventBridge event that initiates the AWS Glue workflow after every successful S3 File Gateway file transfer event.
en_options.C: Set up an on-demand AWS Glue workflow so that the data engineer can start the AWS Glue workflow when each file transfer is complete.
en_options.D: Set up an AWS Lambda function that will invoke the AWS Glue Workflow. Set up an event for the creation of an S3 object as a trigger for the Lambda function.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上擁有商業智慧平台。該公司使用AWSStorageGateway的 AmazonS3FileGateway，將檔案從公司的內部部署環境傳輸至AmazonS3 儲存桶。 資料工程師需要設定一個流程，以便在每次檔案傳輸成功完成時，自動啟動 AWSGlue工作流程來執行一連串的AWSGlue任務。 哪種解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A retail company uses Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL to process and store live transactional data. The company uses an Amazon Redshift cluster for a data warehouse. An extract, transform, and load (ETL) job runs every morning to update the Redshift cluster with new data from the PostgreSQL database. The company has grown rapidly and needs to cost optimize the Redshift cluster. A data engineer needs to create a solution to archive historical data. The data engineer must be able to run analytics queries that effectively combine data from live transactional data in PostgreSQL, current data in Redshift, and archived historical data. The solution must keep only the most recent 15 months of data in Amazon Redshift to reduce costs. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

en_options.A: Configure the Amazon Redshift Federated Query feature to query live transactional data that is in the PostgreSQL database.
en_options.B: Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query live transactional data that is in the PostgreSQL database.
en_options.C: Schedule a monthly job to copy data that is older than 15 months to Amazon S3 by using the UNLOAD command. Delete the old data from the Redshift cluster. Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to access historical data in Amazon S3.
en_options.D: Schedule a monthly job to copy data that is older than 15 months to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval by using the UNLOAD command. Delete the old data from the Redshift cluster. Configure Redshift Spectrum to access historical data from S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
en_options.E: Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift that combines live, current, and historical data from different sources.

zh_question: 一家零售公司使用AmazonAuroraPostgreSQL來處理和儲存即時交易資料。 該公司使用AmazonRedshift叢集作為資料倉儲。 每天早上會執行提取、轉換和載入(ETL)作業，將來自PostgreSQL資料庫的新 資料更新到Redshift叢集。該公司成長迅速，需要對Redshift叢集進行成本優 化。 資料工程師需要建立一個解決方案來歸檔歷史資料。該資料工程師必須能夠執行分 析查詢，有效結合來自PostgreSQL中的即時交易資料、Redshift中的目前資料 以及歸檔的歷史資料。該解決方案必須僅在AmazonRedshift中保留最近15個 月的資料，以降低成本。 哪兩個步驟的組合符合這些需求？（選擇兩項。）

en_question: A manufacturing company has many IoT devices in facilities around the world. The company uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect data from the devices. The data includes device ID, capture date, measurement type, measurement value, and facility ID. The company uses facility ID as the partition key. The company's operations team recently observed many WriteThroughputExceeded exceptions. The operations team found that some shards were heavily used but other shards were generally idle. How should the company resolve the issues that the operations team observed?

en_options.A: Change the partition key from facility ID to a randomly generated key.
en_options.B: Increase the number of shards.
en_options.C: Archive the data on the producer's side.
en_options.D: Change the partition key from facility ID to capture date.

en_question: A data engineer wants to improve the performance of SQL queries in Amazon Athena that run against a sales data table. The data engineer wants to understand the execution plan of a specific SQL statement. The data engineer also wants to see the computational cost of each operation in a SQL query. Which statement does the data engineer need to run to meet these requirements?

en_options.A: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM sales;
en_options.B: EXPLAIN ANALYZE FROM sales;
en_options.C: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM sales;
en_options.D: EXPLAIN FROM sales;

zh_question: 一位資料工程師希望提升在AmazonAthena中針對銷售資料表執行的SQL 查詢效能。 資料工程師想要了解特定SQL陳述式的執行計畫。該資料工程師也希望查看 SQL查詢中每個運算的計算成本。 資料工程師需要執行哪一個陳述式以符合這些需求？

en_question: A company plans to provision a log delivery stream within a VPC. The company configured the VPC flow logs to publish to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company needs to send the flow logs to Splunk in near real time for further analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

en_options.A: Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams data stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to the data stream.
en_options.B: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to the delivery stream.

en_options.D: Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Streams data stream to use Splunk as the destination. Create an AWS Lambda function to send the flow logs from CloudWatch Logs to the data stream.

zh_question: 一家公司計劃在VPC內設定日誌交付串流。該公司 已設定VPC流量記錄以發布至AmazonCloudWatchLogs。 該公司需要將流量記錄近乎即時地傳送至Splunk，以便進行進一步分析。 哪項解決方案能以最低的營運負擔滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company has a data lake on AWS. The data lake ingests sources of data from business units. The company uses Amazon Athena for queries. The storage layer is Amazon S3 with an AWS Glue Data Catalog as a metadata repository. The company wants to make the data available to data scientists and business analysts. However, the company first needs to manage fine-grained, column- level data access for Athena based on the user roles and responsibilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

en_options.A: Set up AWS Lake Formation. Define security policy-based rules for the users and applications by IAM role in Lake Formation.
en_options.B: Define an IAM resource-based policy for AWS Glue tables. Attach the same policy to IAM user groups.

zh_question: 一家公司在AWS上擁有資料湖。該資料湖匯入來自各業務單位的資料來源。该公 司使用AmazonAthena進行查詢。儲存層為AmazonS3，並使用AWSGlue DataCatalog作為程式碼儲存庫。 該公司希望讓資料科學家和業務分析師能夠使用這些資料。然而，公司首先需要 根據使用者的角色與職責，管理針對Athena的細粒度欄位層級資料存取權限。 哪項解決方案能符合這些需求？

en_question: A company has developed several AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) jobs to validate and transform data from Amazon S3. The ETL jobs load the data into Amazon RDS for MySQL in batches once every day. The ETL jobs use a DynamicFrame to read the S3 data. The ETL jobs currently process all the data that is in the S3 bucket. However, the company wants the jobs to process only the daily incremental data. zh_question: 一家公司開發了數個AWSGlue提取、轉換和載入(ETL)作業，用以驗證並轉換 來自AmazonS3的資料。這些ETL作業每天批次將資料載入至AmazonRDS forMySQL一次。這些ETL作業使用DynamicFrame來讀取S3資料。 目前的ETL工作會處理S3儲存桶中的所有資料。然而，公司希望這些工作僅處 理每日的增量資料。 哪種解決方案能以最小的程式撰寫工作量滿足此需求？

en_question: An online retail company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in a VPC. The company wants to collect flow logs for the VPC and analyze network traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

en_options.A: Publish flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.
en_options.B: Publish flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster for analytics.
en_options.C: Publish flow logs to Amazon S3 in text format. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.
en_options.D: Publish flow logs to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. Use Amazon Athena for analytics.

zh_question: 一家線上零售公司擁有一個應用程式，該程式執行於位於VPC中的Amazon EC2執行個體上。该公司希望收集該VPC的流量日誌並分析網路流量。 哪項解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

en_question: A retail company stores transactions, store locations, and customer information tables in four reserved ra3.4xlarge Amazon Redshift cluster nodes. All three tables use even table distribution. The company updates the store location table only once or twice every few years. A data engineer notices that Redshift queues are slowing down because the whole store location table is constantly being broadcast to all four compute nodes for most queries. The data engineer wants to speed up the query performance by minimizing the broadcasting of the store location table. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

en_options.B: Change the distribution style of the store location table to KEY distribution based on the column that has the highest dimension.
en_options.C: Add a join column named store_id into the sort key for all the tables.
en_options.D: Upgrade the Redshift reserved node to a larger instance size in the same instance family.

zh_question: 一家零售公司將交易、門市地點和客戶資訊表儲存在四個保留的ra3.4xlarge AmazonRedshift叢集節點中。所有三個表均使用均勻表分佈。 該公司每隔幾年僅更新一次或兩次門市位置資料表。 一位資料工程師注意到，由於大多數查詢都會將整個門市位置資料表廣播至所 有四個運算節點，導致Redshift佇列變慢。該資料工程師希望透過最小化門 市位置資料表的廣播來提升查詢效能。 哪種解決方案能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？

en_question: A company has a data warehouse that contains a table that is named Sales. The company stores the table in Amazon Redshift. The table includes a column that is named city_name. The company wants to query the table to find all rows that have a city_name that starts with "San" or "El". Which SQL query will meet this requirement?
